messages:
Priya (CS Lead): FYI - several onboarding tenants hit timeouts during large dataset ingestion this morning. need a short status update we can send to affected customers and a plan for credits + QA office hours.
Noah (Success Ops): noted. can we get a 2-sentence root cause + ETA from eng/sre? i'll draft the outbound once we have that.
Diego (Eng): root cause appears to be connection churn + a race in the ingestion coordinator when parallel bundle commits spike. we pushed a throttling patch at 2024-10-03T09:12Z that prevents flapping.
Ruth (SRE): observed timeout window 08:50-09:30 UTC, error rate peak ~6%. we've temporarily increased worker pool and suppressed aggressive retryers to reduce cascading failures. monitoring looks steadier now.
Noah (Success Ops): thanks. draft customer copy suggestion below — keep it short: 
"Hi — we experienced intermittent ingestion timeouts affecting some new onboarding jobs this morning. What we9re doing: a patch was deployed and we9re running a 24h canary while we monitor stability. Next steps: affected accounts will receive a one-time onboarding credit and we9ll host a 30m office hours to answer questions and share the RCA. Link to sign up: https://support.redwood.ai/onboard-ops."
Priya (CS Lead): small edits: change "one-time onboarding credit" to "one-time onboarding credit (applied automatically)", and add an optional office hours recording for those who can't join.
Noah (Success Ops): updated: https://support.redwood.ai/onboard-ops. Office hours scheduled for tomorrow 15:00 UTC; recording will be posted. please react when you9ve reviewed the outbound.
Diego (Eng): :white_check_mark: I9ll attach the brief tech note to the RCA: "Coordinator race under high parallel commits -> throttling guard introduced; add synthetic test for parallel commit burst."
Ruth (SRE): :white_check_mark: also adding alert for commit-rate to worker-capacity ratio and a dashboard panel for affected tenants.
Priya (CS Lead): product okayed the credit policy?
Noah (Success Ops): product signed off for a single one-time credit per affected tenant. ops will queue credits within 48h.
Priya (CS Lead): great. target send: EOD after legal quick-check. who will host office hours?
Noah (Success Ops): i can host CS portion, Diego + Ruth join for tech Q&A. OpsBot will create the calendar event and incident link.
OpsBot: Event created: "Onboarding Ingest Q&A" 60m - 2024-10-04T15:00:00Z. Incident ticket: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2024-1102. Recording will be attached to that ticket.
Priya (CS Lead): thanks team. i9ll prep the customer list and personalize outreach for high-touch accounts. closing thread for now 4: will reopen with RCA and recording.
Noah (Success Ops): closing: will post final outbound copy when legal clears.
OpsBot: Thread status: pending update (RCA + recording).
